Verified directly on the official portal.

specs.photo_size: 35×45 mm (passport standard) — the official page publishes no size or DPI; this is the passport-standard size we apply
specs.head_height_rule: Passport-standard head height
specs.notes: The official ASAN e-Visa portal does not publish a photo size for this document — the figures below are the passport-standard values we apply. Azerbaijan ASAN e-Visa is available online for US, UK and Canada citizens. The official 'Conditions for issuing electronic visas' page (evisa.gov.az/en/conditions) describes attaching a scanned page of a travel document that already carries a photo; no standalone photo upload is specified on the official portal or its public pages.
